 Cade Cunningham flirts with double-double in Friday's win over Heat 
 by Chris Schommer | Pistons Correspondent | Sat, Oct 24th 2026, 10:09am EDT 
 Cade Cunningham flirted with a double-double for the Pistons Friday night, dishing out eight assists and chipping in 16 points (5-8 FG, 2-3 3PT, 4-6 FT) while also grabbing two rebounds, recording one steal, and blocking three shots in a 128-111 win over the Heat. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Cunningham continues an impactful start to the season on the offensive end of the floor, dishing out eight or more assists and scoring 16 or more points in each of the first two contests. The guard remains a dynamic option while continuing to lead an imposing Detroit starting five for head coach JB Bickerstaff, averaging 19.0 points and 8.0 assists per game while carrying a usage rate of 26.5% so far this season.
